in_arabic.name: لقمانة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من لقمان، يعني الحكمة والفهم العميق
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم لقمانة هو اسم مؤنث مشتق من اسم لقمان، الذي ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم كشخصية حكيمة وعاقلة، وقد وردت في سورة لقمان العديد من الآيات التي تشير إلى حكمة لقمان وعلو منزلته عند الله تعالى، ويرتبط الاسم بالحكمة والفهم العميق والقدرة على الاستنتاج الصحيح

in_urdu.name: لقمانہ
in_urdu.meaning: حکمت اور گہری سمجھ سے متعلق، عقلمند، دانا
in_urdu.long_meaning: لقمانہ ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو لقمان سے ماخوذ ہے، جو قرآن کریم میں ایک حکیم اور عقلمند شخص کے طور پر ذکر کیا گیا ہے، اس نام کا تعلق حکمت، گہری سمجھ، اور درست اندازے کی صلاحیت سے ہے، اور یہ اسلامی روایت میں ایک مقدس اور محترم نام ہے

in_hindi.name: लुक़मानाह
in_hindi.meaning: बुद्धिमत्ता और गहरी समझ से संबंधित, बुद्धिमान, ज्ञानी
in_hindi.long_meaning: लुक़मानाह एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो लुक़मान से लिया गया है, जो कुरआन में एक बुद्धिमान और समझदार व्यक्ति के रूप में उल्लेखित है, यह नाम बुद्धिमत्ता, गहरी समझ, और सही अनुमान लगाने की क्षमता से जुड़ा है, और यह इस्लामी परंपरा में एक पवित्र और सम्मानित नाम है

in_pashto.meaning: حکمت او پوهې سره تړاو لري، دانا، هوښیار

in_english.name: Luqmanah
in_english.meaning: Wisdom, deep understanding, and sound judgment
in_english.long_meaning: Luqmanah is a feminine name derived from Luqman, a figure mentioned in the Quran as a wise and understanding person. The name is associated with wisdom, deep insight, and the ability to make sound judgments. In Islamic tradition, Luqman is known for his wise counsel, which is recorded in the Quran (Surah Luqman, Chapter 31). The name Luqmanah reflects these qualities and is considered sacred and respected in Islamic culture.

data.cultural_impact: The name Luqmanah holds significant cultural importance in the Islamic world. It is the name of a wise, pious, and sagacious character mentioned in the Quran. Luqman was a poor man who earned a living by selling firewood. He was known for being a man of wisdom, who passed down his accumulated knowledge to his young son. The story of Luqman and his advice to his son is a cherished one in Islamic culture, and is used as an inspiration and a lesson for moral and ethical conduct in many Islamic societies.
data.spiritual_significance: Luqmanah is a name infused with profound spiritual significance in the Islamic tradition. It is a reminder of the importance of acquiring wisdom and knowledge, and applying it to live a virtuous and meaningful life. The name inspires individuals to be like Luqman, a man of great character, who was loved and respected by those around him due to his inner wisdom and knowledge. The name Luqmanah also signifies the importance of passing on wisdom and knowledge to younger generations, keeping alive the chain of tradition and knowledge acquisition. Ultimately, the name Luqmanah represents the spirit of a wise and pious human being, embodying the best qualities of compassion, wisdom, and kindness.
